The '''Second Mission to Tatooine''' was a mission completed by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]]. After his most recent mission, Denal was sent to investigate a small droid encampment in the desert. Denal proceed with the mission. Everything seemed quiet, until Denal received a message from [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who informed him that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] had been captured and been held in the Separatist prison. Denal infiltrated the enemy base, where he found a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who joined Denal in this mission. Eventually, the mission was completed and Tano was freed.

The next assignment given to Denal was to destroy a Separatist construction yard. It was needed to weaken the defenses of the main Separatist HQ, that was the site of the work on a secret project.
